66321.recognize_zh: 成片細胞質豐富、嗜酸性顆粒狀的組織球 (von Hansemann cells) 中，箭頭處可見圓形、中心深染外圈淡的「標靶狀」細胞質內包涵體，即 Michaelis–Gutmann 小體，為軟斑症 (malakoplakia) 的診斷線索。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, finely granular to foamy cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei
Small round targetoid intracytoplasmic inclusions with a dense core and concentric pale halo (Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, arrows)
Dense admixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells
No sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells in this field
66321.describe_en: Section of bladder wall shows sheets of histiocytes with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm (von Hansemann cells), intermixed with a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Several histiocytes contain round, concentrically laminated targetoid inclusions consistent with Michaelis-Gutmann bodies. The lymphoid component in this field comprises small mature-appearing cells, and a coexisting lymphoma cannot be characterized without immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with malakoplakia; von Kossa or Prussian blue stains would highlight the mineralized Michaelis-Gutmann bodies.

ddx.vs: Xanthogranulomatous inflammation contains lipid-laden foamy macrophages without calcified targetoid Michaelis-Gutmann bodies.
Infectious histiocytic infiltrates form granulomas and show organisms on AFB, GMS or PAS stains rather than von Kossa-positive laminated inclusions.
LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.
MALT lymphoma forms sheets of monotonous CD20-positive centrocyte-like B cells with light chain restriction, whereas the histiocytes here are CD68 positive with Michaelis-Gutmann bodies.

66449.recognize_zh: A–B 面板周邊血中可見偏心核、核周淡染區與深藍細胞質的漿細胞及漿細胞樣淋巴球；流式圖 H 顯示 cytoplasmic kappa/lambda 約 56%/44% 的多株型（polytypic）分布，雖有 CD56+、CD19− 等表面異常，仍支持反應性而非腫瘤性漿細胞。
features: Panels A-B: circulating mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Smaller plasmacytoid lymphocytes with moderate basophilic cytoplasm accompany the plasma cells
Background red cells without rouleaux; no plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli
Panels C-D: CD138+/CD38 bright plasma cell gate with dim CD45 and CD19 negativity
Panels E-G: CD81+, CD27−, CD56+, CD117− plasma cells (partly aberrant-appearing phenotype)
Panel H: cytoplasmic kappa ~56% and lambda ~44%, indicating a polytypic population
66449.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, along with plasmacytoid lymphocytes; no plasmablasts or rouleaux are seen. Flow cytometry identifies a small CD138+ CD38 bright plasma cell population that is CD45 dim, CD19 negative, CD27 negative, CD81 positive, CD56 positive and CD117 negative. Cytoplasmic light chain analysis shows both kappa- and lambda-expressing plasma cells in a near-normal ratio. Despite CD19 loss and CD56 expression, the polytypic light chain pattern and transient course favor reactive plasmacytosis in the setting of chronic inflammatory disease.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell leukemia / circulating myeloma cells
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted (monotypic kappa or lambda) on flow, whereas this population is polytypic.
LPL shows a monotypic CD19+ B-cell component with plasmacytoid differentiation, typically with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis from viral infection (e.g., EBV, dengue)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation rests on clinical context, serology and resolution on follow-up.

66257.recognize_zh: 中央一顆體積遠大於周圍造血細胞的細胞，細胞核呈多葉狀、彼此相連，細胞質大量且充滿細小紫紅色顆粒，這是成熟（產生血小板期）巨核細胞；周圍有各階段骨髓與紅血球系前驅細胞，屬正常骨髓抹片。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding precursors
Single multilobulated, interconnected nucleus with coarse chromatin and no nucleoli (not multinucleated)
Abundant pale lilac cytoplasm densely filled with fine azurophilic granules, indicating a granular/platelet-producing megakaryocyte
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils) and erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
No dysplastic features such as separated nuclear lobes or micro-megakaryocytic forms
66257.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent field with trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A mature megakaryocyte is present, markedly larger than surrounding cells, with a single lobulated interconnected nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. No dysplastic megakaryocytic features, such as hypolobated or widely separated nuclei, are seen. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei with nucleoli, rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small hypolobated micromegakaryocytes or have multiple widely separated nuclei, unlike this normally lobulated cell.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or giant cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells occur in cohesive clusters with nucleoli and lack the finely granular platelet-type cytoplasm.
ET megakaryocytes are hyperlobulated staghorn giant forms in clusters, a judgment requiring biopsy architecture and counts rather than a single cell.

66001.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片的大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡染並呈纖維狀條紋如「揉皺的面紙」（wrinkled tissue paper），小核偏位，夾雜於造血細胞與脂肪間，符合 Gaucher 細胞浸潤。
features: Sheets and clusters of large histiocytes replacing marrow spaces between fat cells
Abundant pale, eosinophilic-to-clear cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated "wrinkled tissue paper" texture
Small, eccentric, dark to angular nuclei
Cell borders distinct, giving a cobblestone/honeycomb pattern
Residual hematopoietic cells, including erythroid and myeloid precursors, compressed between histiocytes
66001.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows extensive infiltration by sheets of large histiocytes that occupy much of the intertrabecular space between adipocytes. The histiocytes have abundant pale cytoplasm with a fibrillary, striated appearance resembling crumpled tissue paper and small, eccentric nuclei. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present between the histiocytic aggregates, and no atypical lymphoid infiltrate or granulomas are seen. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cell infiltration; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur in a background of the associated neoplasm or high cell turnover and with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely bubbly, uniform vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm rather than striated wrinkled cytoplasm.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes can appear striated but are acid-fast positive and often form poorly formed granulomas.

ddx.dx: Metastatic clear cell or signet ring carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia, cohesive clusters and keratin positivity, whereas Gaucher cells are bland CD68-positive histiocytes.

65809.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片完全被中大型、核圓至卵圓、染色質空泡狀的非造血腫瘤細胞取代，細胞被纖細的纖維血管間隔分隔成巢狀，視野中看不到正常造血組織，符合轉移性腫瘤浸潤骨髓。
features: Diffuse replacement of marrow space by sheets and nests of medium-to-large tumor cells
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular to finely granular chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, some cells with clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Delicate fibrovascular septa dividing cells into nests/alveolar-like compartments
No recognizable residual hematopoietic elements (erythroid, myeloid, megakaryocytes) in this field
65809.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows effacement of the marrow space by a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large tumor cells with round-to-oval vesicular nuclei, occasional small nucleoli, and scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. The cells are arranged in sheets and nests separated by delicate fibrovascular septa, and no residual normal hematopoiesis is identified in this field. The nested architecture and cytology favor a non-hematopoietic neoplasm, but the specific lineage cannot be determined on H&E. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a metastatic malignancy; an immunohistochemical panel (e.g., CD45, pancytokeratin, S100/SOX10, synaptophysin, desmin/myogenin, CD99) is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid infiltrates are discohesive, lack nested fibrous septation, and express CD45 with lineage markers.
Carcinoma often forms glands or cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is pancytokeratin positive.

ddx.dx: Small round cell tumors (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: These can show nested or alveolar patterns and are separated by PHOX2B/synaptophysin, myogenin/desmin, or CD99/NKX2.2 immunostains and molecular testing.
Melanoma shows prominent nucleoli, possible pigment, and S100/SOX10/HMB45 positivity.

65745.recognize_zh: 周邊血白血球增多，以成熟單核球為主，並有左移、顆粒減少的嗜中性球與假性 Pelger-Huët 細胞（箭頭）及少數有核紅血球；骨髓抹片單核系增加，但切片細胞量僅約 30%，在化療後兒童需考慮治療相關 JMML。
features: Low power blood: leukocytosis with conspicuous monocytes
Mature monocytes with folded nuclei and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm predominating
Hypogranular neutrophils including pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms and left-shifted granulocytes (arrows)
Occasional circulating nucleated red blood cells (arrow)
Aspirate: increased monocytes and promonocytes with scattered blasts and maturing granulocytes
Core biopsy: hypocellular marrow (~30%) with abundant fat; high power shows mixed myelomonocytic cells
65745.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with absolute monocytosis composed mainly of mature monocytes, left-shifted and hypogranular neutrophils including pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms, and occasional nucleated red blood cells; platelets are decreased. The bone marrow aspirate shows increased monocytes and promonocytes with blasts below 20%, while the core biopsy is hypocellular for age (about 30%) without evidence of the prior tumor. In a child with prior chemoradiotherapy and a somatic KRAS G12D mutation, findings are consistent with therapy-related juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes lack aberrant CD56, are not accompanied by dysplastic neutrophils or nucleated red cells, and no RAS-pathway mutation is found.
AML requires at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas here blasts and promonocytes are 9%.
MDS shows multilineage dysplasia without sustained absolute monocytosis of this degree.
The Noonan disorder occurs in infancy with germline PTPN11/KRAS variants and usually regresses, whereas this KRAS variant is somatic.

65553.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中許多母細胞的核在一側凹陷成杯狀（cup-shaped / fish-mouth），凹陷處細胞質淡染，核染色質細緻、胞質灰藍中等量；杯狀核母細胞常與 FLT3-ITD 及 NPM1 或 NUP98 重排等 AML 相關。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Prominent cup-shaped nuclear invaginations with a pale cytoplasmic zone in the indentation (≥25% of nuclear diameter)
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, occasionally with small vacuoles; some cells with folded, myelomonocytic-appearing nuclei
Cohesive clustering of blasts and a smudged/disrupted cell at left
Background normochromic red cells with no mature granulocytes in this field
65553.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium to large blasts with finely dispersed chromatin and moderate amounts of grey-blue cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles. Many blasts display cup-shaped nuclear invaginations with a pale central cytoplasmic indentation, and some have folded myelomonocytic nuclear contours. A smudged cell is present, and mature granulocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts; this morphology correlates with FLT3-ITD and NPM1 mutation and, as in this case, may accompany NUP98 rearrangement, requiring molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: Cup-like blasts are most classically NPM1-mutated with CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative phenotype, whereas these blasts are CD34+; molecular testing separates them.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed/butterfly nuclei, faggot cells and CD34-/HLA-DR- blasts with PML::RARA, rather than cup-shaped nuclei.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and strong nonspecific esterase, without discrete cup-shaped invagination.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm, no Auer rods and are MPO negative with TdT/B- or T-lineage markers.

65617.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 在瀰漫圓形小淋巴球（CLL/SLL）背景中出現多核巨細胞，核呈花環/葡萄串狀（wreath-like）排列或伴有豐富雙染性細胞質，核特徵與周圍腫瘤細胞相同；CD20、CD5、CD23、LEF1 在巨細胞上同樣陽性，證實為 CLL/SLL 中的 Warthin-Finkeldey 樣細胞而非轉移癌。
features: Diffuse effacement by small round lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Scattered multinucleated giant cells with nuclei arranged in a wreath-like or grape-cluster configuration
Other multinucleated cells with abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm and peripherally placed nuclei
Nuclei of giant cells identical in size and chromatin to the surrounding neoplastic lymphocytes; no nuclear inclusions
IHC: CD20, CD5 and CD23 membranous positivity in both background cells and multinucleated cells
LEF1: diffuse nuclear positivity including multinucleated forms
65617.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement by a monotonous population of small round lymphocytes with clumped chromatin. Scattered among them are multinucleated giant cells with nuclei arranged in wreath-like clusters, as well as multinucleated cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm; their nuclei are cytologically identical to the adjacent neoplastic cells. By immunohistochemistry, both the small cells and the multinucleated cells are positive for CD20, CD5, CD23 and LEF1 (cytokeratin negative, not shown). Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with Warthin-Finkeldey-like multinucleated tumor cells, without evidence of large-cell transformation or metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive with cohesive growth and different nuclear features, whereas these giant cells share the CLL/SLL immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin-like / Richter transformation with Reed-Sternberg-like cells
ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ with loss of CD20 and CD5, unlike these CD5+/CD23+ cells with small bland nuclei.
Occurs in reactive nodes with preserved follicles and viral nuclear/cytoplasmic inclusions, not in a node effaced by a CD5+/CD23+ clonal B-cell population.
Features eosinophilic infiltrates, eosinophilic microabscesses and follicular hyperplasia rather than diffuse CLL/SLL.

65617.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD5, CD23, LEF1

65425.recognize_zh: 五格周邊血抹片拼圖，每格都有一大團由數十到上百顆血小板緊密聚集成的紫色顆粒團塊，團塊內偶夾白血球，周圍則是一般紅血球。在 EDTA 管中看到大量血小板凝集，就要懷疑 EDTA 依賴性假性血小板低下，改用檸檬酸管重驗。
features: Large aggregates composed of numerous densely packed, granular purple platelets
Multiple clumps across all five fields, some very large
Occasional leukocytes entrapped within or adjacent to the clumps
Individual platelets within the clumps have normal size and granulation
Background red cells unremarkable; few free single platelets outside clumps
65425.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood smear fields from an EDTA-anticoagulated sample shows multiple large platelet aggregates composed of densely packed, normally granulated platelets, with occasional entrapped leukocytes; few free platelets are seen between the clumps. Red cells are unremarkable. The automated platelet count is therefore unreliable. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet clumping causing pseudothrombocytopenia; repeat count in a citrate or heparin tube is recommended, as was confirmed in this case.

ddx.vs: In true thrombocytopenia the smear shows few scattered single platelets, often large, without clumps.
Satellitism shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than forming large free aggregates.
Pre-analytic clotting produces fibrin strands with platelet clumps and recurs in any anticoagulant, while EDTA-dependent clumping corrects in citrate.
Inherited macrothrombocytopenias show isolated giant platelets approaching red cell size, sometimes with Döhle-like inclusions, rather than clumps of normal-sized platelets.

65169.recognize_zh: 兩張流式散佈圖中紫色腫瘤族群為 CD34 陰性、CD117 弱陽性（約 10^1）、CD15 陰性，缺乏幹細胞與骨髓性成熟標記；需結合 CD45 陰性、CD56 強陽性的結果判讀，不應誤當成骨髓芽細胞。
features: Left plot (CD117 vs CD34): highlighted population is CD34-negative with dim to moderate CD117 expression
Right plot (CD15 vs CD117): the same population is CD117-positive and CD15-negative
Gray CD15-positive granulocytes are separate from the tumor population
Small green CD34-negative/CD117-negative events near the origin
Plots are ungated; lineage requires correlation with CD45 and CD56 plots
65169.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a dominant population that is CD34 negative, dim to moderately CD117 positive, and CD15 negative, separate from the CD15-positive granulocytes. In isolation, CD117 expression could suggest a myeloid or mast cell population, but in combination with CD45 negativity and bright CD56 expression in the same sample, the population is non-hematopoietic. CD117 expression has been reported in a subset of neuroblastomas. Findings support bone marrow infiltration by metastatic neuroblastoma, with lineage confirmation by GD2 or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are CD45 dim-positive with CD13/CD33 and often HLA-DR or MPO, whereas this CD117-positive population is CD45-negative and CD56-bright.
Mast cells show bright CD117 with high side scatter and CD45 positivity (neoplastic forms CD25/CD2-positive), unlike this dim CD117, CD45-negative population.
Ewing sarcoma can be CD117 and CD56 positive and CD45 negative, so bright CD99 and EWSR1 rearrangement versus GD2/PHOX2B separate it.

65233.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑間原本應有的造血細胞與脂肪幾乎全被淡粉紅的纖維化間質取代，其中散布深染的小細胞團；低倍就能看出「造血消失＋纖維化＋異質細胞巢」，要想到轉移性癌。
features: Low-power core with irregular bony trabeculae
Intertrabecular marrow largely replaced by pale desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Scattered small hyperchromatic nests and cords of tumor cells within the stroma
Near-complete loss of hematopoietic cells and fat
Focal hemorrhage at the core edge
65233.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by pale desmoplastic fibrous stroma, with near-complete loss of hematopoietic elements and fat. Scattered small hyperchromatic cell nests and cords are present throughout the fibrotic areas. Detailed cytology is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive bone marrow involvement by metastatic carcinoma with desmoplasia, in keeping with the known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis retains atypical megakaryocyte clusters and hematopoietic cells in the fibrosis, without cohesive epithelial nests.

ddx.dx: Post-chemotherapy or radiation-related marrow fibrosis/stromal damage
ddx.vs: Treatment-related changes show edematous or fibrotic stroma with hypocellularity but no epithelial tumor nests.
Crush artifact produces smeared chromatin streaks rather than well-formed nests within true collagenous stroma.

65105.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 lambda 免疫染色：大量細胞質強棕色陽性的漿細胞環繞並滲入濾泡周圍與濾泡間區，數量明顯多於一般反應性背景，搭配 kappa 染色比較可支持 HHV8 相關 MCD 的 lambda 偏向。
features: Numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic lambda light-chain staining
Positive cells concentrated around and within the periphery of follicles and in interfollicular areas
Positive cells are round with eccentric nuclei, consistent with plasma cells/plasmablasts
Follicle centers show weak diffuse background staining only
Moderate background staining limits assessment of individual cells at this magnification
65105.describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for lambda light chain shows numerous strongly positive plasmacytoid cells distributed in a band around follicles and throughout interfollicular regions. The follicle centers show only faint background staining. Assessment of light-chain restriction requires side-by-side comparison with kappa, which in this case highlights far fewer cells in the corresponding areas. Findings support a lambda-predominant plasma cell/plasmablast population, consistent with the lambda-restricted plasmablasts characteristic of HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a kappa-to-lambda ratio of roughly 2:1, whereas this case shows lambda predominance with fewer kappa-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: NMZL may be lambda-restricted but shows expanded monotypic marginal zone B cells and lacks HHV8 LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.
Plasmacytoma diffusely effaces the node with monotypic mature plasma cells, whereas here follicular architecture is preserved and the lambda-positive cells are mantle/interfollicular.

64273.recognize_zh: 這張骨髓切片其實是一張未標明抗體的免疫組織化學染色：背景密集的不成熟細胞片狀浸潤呈陰性，只有零星散在、形狀不規則的細胞（含少數較大細胞）呈棕色陽性，可用來顯示腫瘤細胞以外殘存的正常細胞群。
features: Hypercellular trephine with sheets of uniform immature cells that are immunonegative (hematoxylin counterstain only)
Scattered brown-positive cells with irregular, dendritic or elongated shapes distributed interstitially
A few larger positive cells/clusters (upper left), possibly megakaryocytes or macrophages
Fat spaces and bone trabecula outlines at low power; antibody not specified in the record, limiting interpretation
64273.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (antibody not specified) shows a hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of immature cells that are negative. Only scattered interstitial cells with irregular to dendritic shapes, and a few larger cells, show brown cytoplasmic/membranous staining, suggesting a residual non-neoplastic population such as macrophages, myeloid cells or megakaryocytes. Because the antigen is not identified, specific interpretation is limited; in the context of pure erythroid leukemia, the neoplastic infiltrate would be expected to be negative for myeloid/megakaryocytic markers and positive for E-cadherin, CD71 and glycophorin/hemoglobin.

ddx.vs: AMKL blasts would be diffusely positive for CD61/CD42b, whereas here only scattered cells stain and the blast sheet is negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myeloid (MPO-positive) blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloblast-rich AML would show diffuse MPO/CD34 positivity in the sheets, unlike this pattern with a negative dominant population; E-cadherin/CD71 positivity supports erythroid lineage.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Non-myeloid tumors are separated by lineage-specific markers (cytokeratin, CD99/FLI1, CD20/CD3) rather than by this scattered-cell staining pattern.

64465.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結呈結節狀並有纖維帶分隔，高倍見多分葉大型異型細胞散在於淋巴球、組織球、嗜酸性球的混合背景中，看起來像典型何杰金淋巴瘤；但 CD30 陽性的大細胞數量多且成片，FISH 顯示 JAK2 分離並伴 3′ 端擴增，指向 ALK 陰性 ALCL。
features: Panel A: effaced lymph node with a nodular growth pattern separated by broad fibrous bands
Panel B: large atypical cells with multilobated or horseshoe-shaped nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli
Panel B: mixed background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and eosinophils
Panel C: CD30 strong membranous and Golgi staining in numerous large cells, forming dense clusters
Panel D: JAK2 break-apart FISH with separated green (5′) and multiple red (3′) signals indicating rearrangement with 3′ amplification
64465.describe_en: Lymph node sections show effaced architecture with a nodular pattern and bands of sclerosis (panel A). At high power, large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei and prominent nucleoli are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and eosinophils (panel B), closely mimicking nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma. The large cells are strongly and diffusely CD30 positive with membranous and Golgi staining in dense clusters (panel C). JAK2 break-apart FISH shows split signals with amplification of the 3′ probe (panel D). With the reported cytotoxic, T-cell clonal, ALK-negative, PAX5-negative profile, findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma with JAK2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are weakly PAX5 positive, usually lack cytotoxic markers and clonal TCR rearrangement, and are fewer in number than the CD30+ cells here.
ALK-positive ALCL shows ALK protein expression by IHC and ALK rearrangement, which are negative here.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows heterogeneous, variable CD30 staining rather than uniform strong CD30 in all neoplastic cells with hallmark-type morphology.
These are B-cell lineage tumors expressing PAX5, CD20, and CD79a, which are negative in this case.

64465.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30; FISH: JAK2 break-apart

64145.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞，胞質豐富呈淡紫色細顆粒狀（已成熟），但核只有一個圓到橢圓形、完全沒有分葉；成熟胞質配上不分葉的單核，是 MDS（特別是 del(5q)）常見的發育異常巨核細胞。
features: Large megakaryocyte, many times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Single round-to-oval, non-lobated nucleus, relatively small for the cell size
Coarsely granular chromatin without visible nucleoli
Abundant, finely granular pale violaceous cytoplasm indicating cytoplasmic maturity
Background with a band neutrophil, a small lymphocyte, and scattered platelet clumps
64145.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant, finely granular mature cytoplasm and a single round, non-lobated nucleus. The nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (mature cytoplasm with an unsegmented nucleus) indicates megakaryocytic dysplasia. Adjacent cells include a band neutrophil and a small lymphocyte; no blasts are present in this field. A single cell is insufficient for diagnosis, but in the appropriate context the finding is suggestive of a myelodysplastic neoplasm, particularly MDS with isolated del(5q), and warrants karyotype/FISH.

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes have a non-lobated nucleus but deeply basophilic, scant-to-moderate cytoplasm without the abundant granular maturation seen here.
Micromegakaryocytes are small, about the size of a myelocyte with a single small nucleus, whereas this cell is large.
ET shows large hyperlobulated 'staghorn' megakaryocytes and CML shows small hypolobated forms, both with BCR::ABL1 or JAK2/CALR/MPL context rather than del(5q).
Multiple widely separated round nuclei ('pawn-ball') are another dysplastic form, distinct from this single unlobated nucleus.

64081.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片三格組圖中（箭頭處），多顆漿細胞的胞質被一顆顆淡藍灰色的圓形小球填滿，像一串葡萄、把核遮住或推到一側；胞質內滿是 Russell body 的 Mott cell，本例見於漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Multiple plasma cells with cytoplasm packed by numerous pale blue-gray, round, uniform globules (Russell bodies), giving a grape-cluster or morula appearance
Nuclei round, eccentric, with clumped chromatin, partly obscured by the inclusions
Mott cells occur singly and in small groups (arrowheads)
Admixed conventional plasma cells, maturing granulocytes, and erythroid precursors
Stretched nuclear strand and a few smudged cells in the bottom panel are smearing artifacts
64081.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (three fields) shows numerous Mott cells, plasma cells whose cytoplasm is distended by multiple round, pale blue-gray globular inclusions (Russell bodies) that partially obscure eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin. Conventional plasma cells are also present, admixed with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Russell bodies represent accumulated immunoglobulin within dilated endoplasmic reticulum. Mott cells are not specific for malignancy; in this context the findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, and plasma cell percentage and light-chain restriction should be established.

ddx.vs: Morphology alone cannot separate them; reactive states show polytypic kappa/lambda expression and fewer plasma cells without an M-protein.
Dutcher bodies are single intranuclear-appearing PAS-positive inclusions overlying the nucleus, rather than multiple cytoplasmic globules.
These are giant azurophilic or dense granules in granulocytes/blasts, not pale uniform globules filling plasma cell cytoplasm.
Histiocytes are larger with small central nuclei and crumpled-tissue-paper or foamy cytoplasm, lacking plasma cell nuclear features.

64017.recognize_zh: 厚片中紅血球已溶解只剩淡色影子，背景散佈許多帶棕黑色瘧色素、形狀不規則的滋養體，下方可見一個由多個裂殖子聚成的裂殖體（schizont），同時存在多個不同時期，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）厚片。
features: Thick film with lysed red cells leaving pale ghost outlines; platelets appear as small pink clusters
Numerous irregular, amoeboid trophozoites with dark chromatin and brown-black pigment
Schizont composed of a cluster of numerous merozoites with a clumped pigment mass (lower center)
Larger round, densely stained parasite forms compatible with gametocytes
Multiple developmental stages present simultaneously
64017.describe_en: Thick blood film (Giemsa stain) shows lysed red cells in the background with numerous malaria parasites. There are many irregular, amoeboid trophozoites containing chromatin and brown pigment, larger round compact forms compatible with gametocytes, and a schizont with multiple merozoites and a clumped pigment mass. The presence of all developmental stages, with amoeboid trophozoites, favors a non-falciparum species. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection; species confirmation and parasitemia estimation should use the thin film.

ddx.vs: Falciparum thick films usually show numerous small uniform rings, with crescentic gametocytes and schizonts rarely present in peripheral blood.
P. malariae has compact (non-amoeboid) trophozoites with coarse pigment and schizonts of 6-12 merozoites, often in a rosette, and usually low parasitemia.
Ovale trophozoites are more compact, and the thick film cannot reliably separate it from vivax, so thin-film red cell features or PCR are needed.
Platelet aggregates are pink-purple granular clusters without discrete chromatin dots, blue cytoplasm or golden-brown pigment.

63889.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大原紅血球，核圓大、染色質細緻偏紅紫，細胞質為深藍色，邊緣向外伸出兩個鈍圓突起，像狗耳朵（dog ears）；旁邊有正常顆粒球與小淋巴球可比較大小，在紅系再生不良中提示 parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Giant proerythroblast much larger than adjacent granulocytes and lymphocyte
Large round nucleus with finely granular, reddish-purple chromatin and small pink nuclear granules
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm forming a rim around the nucleus
Two blunt, deeply basophilic cytoplasmic projections (pseudopodia resembling dog ears)
Neighboring metamyelocyte/band neutrophil with fine granules and a small lymphocyte
63889.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant proerythroblast with a large round nucleus, finely granular reddish-purple chromatin and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm forms two blunt, dark blue pseudopod-like projections resembling dog ears. Adjacent granulocytic precursors and a small lymphocyte provide size comparison. Giant proerythroblasts with such cytoplasmic projections in an erythroid-depleted marrow are characteristic of parvovirus B19 infection and should be confirmed by PCR or immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast with cytoplasmic pseudopodia in pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs but have less intensely blue cytoplasm, may bud platelets and are CD41/CD61-positive rather than glycophorin/E-cadherin-positive.
Normal proerythroblasts are smaller, occur with a full maturing erythroid series and lack intranuclear inclusions or giant size.
AML blasts form an increased population with granules or Auer rods and myeloid markers, not isolated giant erythroid precursors.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and express CD138, lacking dog-ear cytoplasmic projections.

63825.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中上排門牙的牙齦明顯腫大、暗紅發亮，部分覆蓋牙冠頸部，下排牙齦也發紅腫脹；在白血球升高且單核球比例高的急性白血病病人身上，這種牙齦增生提示單核球分化的 AML（如急性骨髓單核球白血病）浸潤牙齦。
features: Clinical photograph of the mouth with lips parted showing upper and lower anterior teeth
Swollen, dusky red to violaceous, glistening gingiva along the upper incisors extending over the cervical tooth margins
Interdental papillae enlarged and bulbous
Similar erythematous swelling of the lower gingival margin
No histologic information; plaque/staining of teeth also visible
63825.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows diffuse gingival enlargement involving the upper and lower anterior gingiva, with swollen, dusky red and glistening marginal gingiva and bulbous interdental papillae partly covering the cervical portions of the teeth. In a patient with leukocytosis, monocytosis and marrow blasts with monocytic differentiation, this appearance is consistent with leukemic infiltration of the gingiva, a classic extramedullary manifestation of acute myelomonocytic and monocytic leukemia. Biopsy is rarely required but would show infiltration by monocytic blasts.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth (phenytoin, cyclosporine, calcium-channel blockers)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced overgrowth is firm, pale pink and fibrous without bleeding and occurs with a relevant drug history and normal blood counts.
Scurvy causes spongy bleeding gums with perifollicular hemorrhages and corkscrew hairs but no circulating blasts or monocytosis.
Inflammatory gingivitis is localized to plaque-laden margins without massive diffuse enlargement or abnormal blood counts.

ddx.dx: Gingival involvement by other neoplasms (e.g., myeloid sarcoma, plasmablastic lymphoma)
ddx.vs: These form localized masses rather than diffuse symmetric enlargement and are distinguished by biopsy with immunohistochemistry.

63761.recognize_zh: H&E 可見中到大型、多形性、核仁明顯的淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤；免疫染色 CD2、CD43 膜陽性，CD30 強而瀰漫、MUM1 核陽性，但 CD45、CD3、CD5 皆陰性，加上 TCR 基因重組單株峰（panel i），指向 T 細胞表型殘缺的原發性中樞神經 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with round-oval nuclei, some with distinct nucleoli, scant to moderate cytoplasm (H&E, panel a)
CD2 and CD43 membranous positivity in the tumor cells
Strong diffuse membranous/Golgi CD30 and strong nuclear MUM1
CD45, CD3 and CD5 negative in tumor cells with only rare positive background cells (internal control)
Capillary electrophoresis of TCR gamma rearrangement with a single dominant clonal peak (panel i)
63761.describe_en: Brain biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, occasional distinct nucleoli and scant to moderate cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are positive for CD2 and CD43, strongly and diffusely positive for CD30 and MUM1, and negative for CD45, CD3 and CD5, with scattered positive background cells serving as internal controls. TCR gamma gene rearrangement studies show a dominant monoclonal peak. The combination of an aberrant T-cell phenotype with loss of pan-T antigens and CD45, CD30 expression and clonal TCR rearrangement, in the absence of systemic disease, is most compatible with primary CNS T-cell lymphoma; ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma must be considered given uniform CD30.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PCNSL-DLBCL is CD20/PAX5/CD79a positive and CD2/CD43-only T-cell phenotype with clonal TCR would not be seen.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, uniformly strong CD30 and frequent cytotoxic markers/EMA, and needs systemic staging; this case is TIA-1, granzyme B and EMA negative.
Carcinoma and melanoma are CD45-negative too but express keratins or S100/SOX10 and lack CD2/CD43 and clonal TCR.
Gliomas are GFAP/OLIG2 positive with fibrillary background and lack lymphoid markers.

63761.stain: H&E; IHC: CD2, CD43, CD30, MUM1, CD45, CD3, CD5

63697.recognize_zh: 數顆淋巴球的卵圓形核染色質緻密，細胞質往兩極延伸成尖細尾巴，呈紡錘形（fusiform）且有極性的細胞質突起；背景紅血球普遍皺縮成棘狀。
features: Several small to medium lymphoid cells with oval nuclei and dense chromatin
Bipolar tapering pale-blue cytoplasmic projections giving a spindle (fusiform) shape
Scant to moderate agranular cytoplasm
Nucleoli not visible
Background crenated (echinocytic) red cells, likely artifact; one small round lymphocyte and scattered platelets
63697.describe_en: Peripheral blood film (Leishman) shows several small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant pale cytoplasm drawn out into polar tapering projections, producing a spindle-shaped appearance. Nucleoli are not appreciable and the cytoplasm lacks granules. Red cells show diffuse crenation, likely a preparation artifact. In a patient with massive splenomegaly, circulating lymphoid cells with polarized cytoplasmic projections are suggestive of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; immunophenotyping and splenic or bone marrow histology are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells show circumferential rather than polar projections, abundant pale cytoplasm, and CD25/CD103/CD123/annexin A1 positivity.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based polar villi and morphology overlapping SMZL, requiring splenic histology showing red pulp rather than white pulp involvement.
HCL-variant cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD103 positive but CD25 negative.
Artifactual spindling occurs in thick dragged areas and lacks true villi, so it should be judged in well-spread monolayer areas.

63633.recognize_zh: 大多數紅血球的中央淡染區不是圓形，而是一條細長像嘴巴或裂縫的蒼白帶（slit-like central pallor），整片均勻出現，這就是口形紅血球（stomatocyte）。
features: Normocytic red cells, the majority showing a linear, slit- or mouth-like central pallor (stomatocytes)
Occasional cells with round central pallor and rare target-like forms
No significant spherocytes, schistocytes or red cell inclusions evident
Scattered normal-appearing platelets
Segmented neutrophil with normal granulation (lower right)
63633.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell population dominated by stomatocytes, with a linear slit-like central pallor replacing the normal round pallor in most cells. Red cells are otherwise fairly uniform in size, without significant spherocytes, schistocytes or nucleated red cells in this field. Platelets appear adequate and the neutrophil seen is morphologically unremarkable. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis; in this clinical setting (severe COVID-19 with liver injury) an acquired cause is favored, but the possibility of drying artifact should be excluded by confirming the finding in well-spread areas of a fresh smear.

ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes are confined to thick parts of the smear, whereas true stomatocytosis is present uniformly in the thin monolayer.
Hereditary forms show chronic compensated hemolysis, abnormal MCHC and osmotic gradient ektacytometry, and family history rather than an acquired transient pattern.
SAO cells are oval with one or two transverse slits or bars rather than round cells with a single mouth-like pallor.
Target cells have a central dense hemoglobin spot surrounded by a pale ring, not a linear slit.

63569.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：小腿遠端有一個圓形小潰瘍，中央為淡白色痂皮與少量出血點，周圍一圈暗褐色色素沉著，附近另有數個淡色舊疤；鐮刀型貧血病人踝上小腿的慢性潰瘍是典型併發症。
features: Single small, round, shallow ulcer over the distal lower leg
Ulcer base with whitish fibrinous/scaly material and small punctate hemorrhagic foci
Well-demarcated ring of dark hyperpigmentation surrounding the ulcer
Additional faint hyperpigmented macules/scars on the adjacent leg suggesting prior lesions
No surrounding cellulitis, purulent discharge or necrotic eschar visible
63569.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a small, round, shallow ulcer on the distal lower leg with a pale fibrinous and scaly base containing punctate hemorrhagic foci, surrounded by a well-demarcated rim of hyperpigmentation. Several faint hyperpigmented areas nearby suggest previously healed lesions. There is no visible surrounding erythema, purulence, or necrotic eschar. In a patient with sickle cell anemia and laboratory evidence of hemolysis (elevated LDH and bilirubin), the findings are consistent with a chronic or healing sickle cell leg ulcer.

ddx.vs: Venous ulcers occur with varicosities, edema and lipodermatosclerosis in older patients without hemolytic disease.
Pyoderma gangrenosum has painful, rapidly enlarging ulcers with undermined violaceous borders and pathergy.
Ecthyma shows punched-out ulcers with thick adherent crust and purulent base with positive cultures, often with surrounding cellulitis.
Hydroxyurea ulcers arise near the malleoli during treatment and heal after drug discontinuation.

63377.recognize_zh: 一個大型組織球（histiocyte）的空泡化細胞質內，同時含有被吞噬的有核紅血球（外圍有透明暈）、數顆紅血球與一個白血球樣細胞，旁邊還有其他有核細胞，這是典型的噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant vacuolated, pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Engulfed orthochromatic normoblast surrounded by a clear phagocytic vacuole
Multiple ingested red cells, some distorted, within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Ingested or closely apposed nucleated cells, including a cell with an indented nucleus and small granular debris/platelets
Background of normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
63377.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing an engulfed nucleated red cell within a clear vacuole, several phagocytosed red cells and fragments of other cellular material. Additional nucleated cells are closely associated with or partly engulfed by the histiocyte. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, splenomegaly, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact cells within a megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not within a histiocyte with a single oval nucleus.

ddx.dx: Overlapping cells in a thick smear
ddx.vs: Overlying cells lie in different planes without surrounding clear vacuoles, whereas phagocytosed cells sit in vacuoles within the histiocyte cytoplasm.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes show emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and plasma cells and are S100-positive, typically in lymph nodes rather than marrow.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact red cells and nucleated precursors.

63313.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中有一條細長、彎曲的蟲體，內部可見一列藍紫色細胞核（nuclear column），蟲體外有淡色的鞘（sheath），這是微絲蟲（microfilaria）的典型外觀；依病例說明為班氏絲蟲（Wuchereria bancrofti）。
features: Single elongated, gently undulating worm many times the length of a red cell, lying among erythrocytes
Body filled with a column of dark blue-purple somatic nuclei
Thin pale sheath-like outline running along the body
One end (left) is tapered and embedded in a purple amorphous/fibrinous clump, limiting assessment of tail-tip nuclei
Background of dense erythrocytes with scattered platelets; no specific host-cell reaction around the parasite
63313.describe_en: Smear (reported as bone marrow aspirate, Jenner-Giemsa) shows a single elongated, sheathed microfilaria with a gently curved body lying among erythrocytes. The body contains a column of darkly staining somatic nuclei, and one end tapers within an amorphous purple fibrin-like clump. The tail tip and the distribution of terminal nuclei cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a sheathed microfilaria, compatible with Wuchereria bancrofti in the appropriate clinical and geographic setting.

ddx.vs: Brugia is also sheathed but has a sheath staining pink with Giemsa, a kinked body, and two separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip, whereas W. bancrofti has smooth curves and no nuclei in the tail tip.
Loa loa is sheathed but its nuclear column extends continuously to the tip of the tail, and the sheath often stains poorly with Giemsa.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller, unsheathed, and have nuclei extending to a blunt tail tip.
Artifacts lack an organized internal column of discrete nuclei and a defined tapered anterior and posterior end.

63185.recognize_zh: MPO 細胞化學染色中，左下與中央的顆粒球細胞質呈棕色陽性，右側一顆核過度分葉的嗜中性球細胞質卻完全淡染無棕色顆粒，代表這顆發育異常的嗜中性球 MPO 陰性。
features: Myeloperoxidase cytochemistry on peripheral blood with blue nuclear counterstain
Neutrophil on the right with multiple (hypersegmented) nuclear lobes and pale cytoplasm lacking brown MPO reaction product
Adjacent granulocytes (center and lower left) show brown granular MPO positivity as internal positive controls
Unstained red cells in the background, some with target-like central pallor
63185.describe_en: Myeloperoxidase cytochemical stain of a peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes with strong brown granular cytoplasmic positivity, serving as internal positive controls. In contrast, a neutrophil with abnormal nuclear hypersegmentation shows complete absence of MPO reaction product in its cytoplasm. In a patient with a myelodysplastic neoplasm, findings are consistent with acquired MPO deficiency in dysplastic neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Inherited MPO deficiency affects essentially all neutrophils uniformly, whereas here MPO-negative neutrophils coexist with normally positive granulocytes.
Those cells have non-lobated nuclei, whereas this MPO-negative cell has a multilobed neutrophil nucleus.
Megaloblastic neutrophils are hypersegmented but retain normal MPO activity, so MPO loss favors a clonal dysplastic process.

63121.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色低倍下，大量深棕色陽性細胞密集分布於骨小樑周圍並延伸至間質，與中央脂肪造血區的陰性形成對比，支持濾泡性淋巴瘤（BCL2 異常表現）侵犯骨髓。
features: IHC for BCL2 on bone marrow core biopsy, low power
Densely positive lymphoid cells concentrated in paratrabecular bands
Positive cells extend into interstitial sheets
Intertrabecular fat and hematopoietic areas contain fewer positive cells
Subcellular pattern not resolvable at this magnification
63121.describe_en: BCL2 immunostain at low power shows numerous strongly positive lymphoid cells concentrated in paratrabecular bands and interstitial sheets, whereas the intertrabecular fat and hematopoietic regions are largely negative. Because normal T cells also express BCL2, interpretation relies on concordance with the CD19/CD20/CD10-positive infiltrate. BCL2 expression in a CD10-positive B-cell population supports follicular lymphoma, here with large-cell transformation.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells are BCL2+ but CD3+ and CD20/CD10 negative; co-localization with CD10+ B cells is required.
Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically BCL2-negative or weak, unlike this strongly BCL2-positive infiltrate.

ddx.dx: De novo diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: De novo DLBCL may also express BCL2; transformation from FL is established by history, residual low-grade component, or clonal relationship (t(14;18)).

63057.recognize_zh: 黑箭頭是多核、核呈分離圓形而非分葉的巨核細胞，紅箭頭是約前骨髓細胞大小的微小巨核細胞；紫箭頭的嗜中性球顆粒少、分葉異常，對照綠箭頭的正常嗜中性球，顯示多系發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte (black arrow) with multiple widely separated round, non-lobated nuclei in abundant blue cytoplasm
Micromegakaryocyte (red arrow): promyelocyte-sized cell with two small round dense nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic neutrophil (purple arrow): hypogranular cytoplasm with abnormal nuclear segmentation and clumped chromatin
Normal granulated segmented neutrophil (green arrow) for comparison
Cellular smear with granulocytic and erythroid precursors, central clump of cells
63057.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with a mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including a multinucleated form with widely separated round non-lobated nuclei and a small micromegakaryocyte approximately the size of a promyelocyte. Scattered neutrophils show cytoplasmic hypogranularity and abnormal nuclear segmentation compared with adjacent normal neutrophils. Findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia in a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm; blast enumeration and cytogenetics are required.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (e.g., post-chemotherapy recovery, ITP)
ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes may be increased or young but remain large with lobated nuclei, without micromegakaryocytes or separated round nuclei.
Morphology is identical; separation rests on documented prior cytotoxic therapy or radiation.
Osteoclasts have multiple uniform separate nuclei each with a nucleolus and granular pink cytoplasm, unlike megakaryocytes with dense chromatin and bluish cytoplasm.
B12/folate deficiency shows hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblastic erythroid nuclei with open chromatin, and resolves with replacement.

62993.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 IgG4 免疫染色下，許多漿細胞呈強細胞質陽性，散在或成小群分布於淋巴球之間；與 IgG 染色對照，IgG4 陽性細胞比例偏高（IgG4/IgG >40%），支持 IgG4 豐富的漿細胞浸潤。
features: Numerous plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic IgG4 staining and eccentric unstained nuclei
Positive cells scattered singly and in small clusters throughout the interfollicular tissue
Density of IgG4+ cells high enough to be counted per high-power field on comparison with the IgG stain
Background small lymphocytes negative; minimal nonspecific background staining
62993.describe_en: IgG4 immunostain of the lymph node shows numerous IgG4-positive plasma cells distributed singly and in small clusters among negative small lymphocytes. Compared with the companion IgG stain, the IgG4:IgG ratio exceeds 40%. Findings indicate an increase in IgG4-positive plasma cells; this is supportive of, but not specific for, IgG4-related disease and must be interpreted with the clinical context, here a patient with systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Requires correlation with clinical, serologic and other organ findings, because increased IgG4+ plasma cells alone are not diagnostic.
Castleman disease may show increased IgG4+ cells but has characteristic follicular changes, sheets of plasma cells and systemic inflammation with high IL-6/CRP.
Rosai-Dorfman disease can harbor many IgG4+ plasma cells but is defined by S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted on kappa/lambda ISH, whereas IgG4-rich reactive plasma cells are polytypic.

62929.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片可見成團聚集的腫瘤細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細顆粒狀、細胞質界線不清，部分細胞彼此擠壓並埋在淡粉紅纖維狀背景中，另見許多被壓碎的細胞；成團（cohesive）排列是非造血腫瘤轉移的線索。
features: Cohesive clusters of intermediate to large tumor cells with round to oval nuclei
Finely granular chromatin with occasional small nucleoli; high N:C ratio
Indistinct, pale cytoplasmic borders with cells merging into a pale pink fibrillary background
Nuclear crowding/molding and numerous crushed cells with smeared chromatin
Blue-green lysed red cells and stromal material in background
62929.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several cohesive aggregates of non-hematopoietic-appearing tumor cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and scant ill-defined cytoplasm, and they lie within a faint pink fibrillary matrix; nuclear molding and crush artifact are prominent. Definite rosettes are not evident in this field. The cohesive growth pattern argues against acute leukemia, and in conjunction with CD45-negative/CD56-positive flow cytometry and synaptophysin/NSE positivity, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed single cells in a clean background and are CD45+/TdT+, unlike these cohesive CD45-negative clusters.
Clusters of small round cells without neuropil; distinguished by membranous CD99, NKX2.2, and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Blasts may clump and appear cohesive, but they are CD45 dim-positive and CD41/CD61 positive rather than synaptophysin positive.

62865.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以各階段紅血球母細胞為主（紅系增生），可見數顆晚期紅血球母細胞具兩個大小相等、並排的深染圓形核（雙核），另有核形不規則的細胞，是 CDA II 的典型骨髓表現。
features: Marked erythroid predominance with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation
Several late erythroblasts with two equal-sized, adjacent round dense nuclei (binucleation)
Early erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with granular chromatin
Occasional cells with irregular or lobulated nuclear contours
Few granulocytic precursors; background red cells
62865.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation, including basophilic normoblasts with deeply blue cytoplasm and numerous polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts. Several late erythroblasts contain two equal-sized, adjacent round nuclei, and occasional cells show irregular nuclear outlines. Granulocytic precursors are relatively sparse. Erythroid hyperplasia with equal-sized binucleate late erythroblasts is consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts connected by internuclear chromatin bridges, with binucleation less prominent.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with reactive erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia lacks significant binucleation and is associated with a brisk reticulocytosis.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic neoplasm or acute erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: These show dysplasia in other lineages, megaloblastoid change, clonal abnormalities (e.g., TP53) and, in erythroid leukemia, many pronormoblasts.

62737.recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色低倍下，骨髓顆粒（particle）以脂肪空泡為主、造血細胞稀少，顆粒內充滿大片深藍色含鐵血黃素沉積，屬 4–5+ 的明顯增加鐵儲存，符合再生不良性貧血等紅血球生成低下時鐵未被利用的表現。
features: Marrow particles composed largely of fat vacuoles with scant hematopoietic cellularity
Heavy, confluent blue (Prussian blue-positive) hemosiderin deposits throughout the particles
Iron stores grade approximately 4-5+ on low-power assessment
Iron located within particle stroma/macrophages rather than dispersed in the smear background
62737.describe_en: Perls (Prussian blue) stain of a bone marrow aspirate at low power shows fatty marrow particles with sparse hematopoietic cells and abundant, confluent blue-staining hemosiderin deposits within the particles. Storage iron is markedly increased (grade approximately 4-5+). Sideroblastic iron in erythroid precursors cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with pancytopenia, the fatty hypocellular particles and increased storage iron are consistent with the findings of aplastic anemia; the diagnosis requires trephine biopsy cellularity assessment.

ddx.vs: Also shows increased storage iron, but particles are normocellular and sideroblasts are reduced, without fatty hypocellular marrow.
Iron is markedly increased with any cellularity, so the history of transfusion and serum ferritin/HFE studies are needed to separate them.
Storage iron is increased but particles are usually cellular and high-power examination shows ring sideroblasts in 15% or more of erythroid precursors.
Morphology of the iron stain cannot distinguish it; dysplasia, blasts and cytogenetic abnormalities on marrow examination favor hypoplastic MDS.

62673.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見大量密集、形狀相近的濾泡，濾泡內細胞核呈 BCL6 棕色陽性，濾泡間區則大多陰性，勾勒出背靠背（back-to-back）的濾泡結構，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma）的生發中心表現型。
features: Numerous closely packed, variably sized nodules effacing the nodal architecture at low power
Nuclear BCL6 positivity concentrated within the nodules (germinal center B-cell phenotype)
Interfollicular zones largely BCL6-negative with scattered positive cells
Follicles lack a distinct mantle-zone rim and show little size/shape variation, some confluent
Weaker staining pale areas within some follicles
62673.describe_en: Low-power BCL6 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows effacement of the architecture by numerous crowded, back-to-back neoplastic follicles. The follicles show nuclear BCL6 expression, while the intervening interfollicular tissue is largely negative, highlighting the nodular pattern. Staining supports a germinal center B-cell derivation of the follicles; distinction from reactive follicles requires BCL2 co-expression and architectural/cytologic correlation. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are BCL6-positive too but are well separated, vary in size and shape, have polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Marginal zone cells are BCL6-negative, so BCL6 staining is confined to residual colonized germinal centers rather than filling the entire nodule.
Mantle cell lymphoma nodules are BCL6-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

62609.recognize_zh: Kappa 原位雜交低倍圖：左側腫瘤結節與浸潤帶呈彌漫深藍色 kappa 訊號，右側小腸黏膜漿細胞亦陽性；與 lambda 染色時腫瘤陰性對照，確認為 kappa 限制性。
features: Low-power ISH section of bowel wall: tumor on left, small intestinal mucosa on right
Diffuse dense kappa signal throughout the tumor nodules in the deep wall
Kappa-positive normal plasma cells in lamina propria of villi (internal control)
Fibromuscular septa and vessels between tumor and mucosa unstained
62609.describe_en: Kappa light chain in situ hybridization shows diffuse strong signal throughout the neoplastic infiltrate in the deep bowel wall, in addition to scattered positive plasma cells in the adjacent normal lamina propria. Compared with the corresponding lambda ISH, in which the tumor is negative while mucosal plasma cells stain, the tumor shows kappa light-chain restriction. This establishes clonality of the plasma cell proliferation and is consistent with monomorphic plasmacytoma-like PTLD, EBV+.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are positive for both kappa and lambda in a mixed pattern, not kappa-only sheets.
Non-destructive plasmacytic hyperplasia is usually polytypic, whereas this destructive lesion is kappa-restricted.
Interpretation is validated by the lambda-stained section showing tumor negativity with positive mucosal controls.

62545.recognize_zh: 兒童骨髓切片中造血組織呈斑塊狀，與脂肪細胞交錯；可見成群的紅血球系前驅細胞島，以及小型、核分葉少或核分離的巨核細胞（左中央有多個分開圓核的巨核細胞），骨髓細胞相對少，符合兒童難治性血球低下（RCC）的表現。
features: Patchy hematopoiesis with interspersed adipocytes and loose, edematous stroma at the top
Erythroid islands of round-nucleated precursors at varying maturation stages, including immature forms
Megakaryocytes that are small or show multiple separated round nuclei
Relatively few granulocytic precursors
Scattered extravasated red cells and eosinophilic precursors
62545.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows patchy hematopoietic tissue alternating with adipocytes and loose stroma. Erythroid islands with immature and maturing precursors are present, granulopoiesis is relatively decreased, and megakaryocytes include small forms and cells with multiple widely separated round nuclei. The overall cellularity cannot be reliably assessed from this single high-power field. In a child with persistent cytopenia, these findings are suggestive of refractory cytopenia of childhood, and exclusion of inherited marrow failure syndromes and severe aplastic anemia is required.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows diffuse marked hypocellularity with lymphocytes and mast cells and without erythroid islands or dysplastic megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (e.g., Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, so chromosome breakage, telomere length, and germline testing are needed.
Reactive hypoplasia usually lacks megakaryocytic dysplasia and resolves on follow-up without a clonal abnormality.

62481.recognize_zh: CD43 染色中大片淡藍色的腫瘤性小 B 細胞為陰性，只有散在與帶狀分布的反應性 T 細胞呈膜染色陽性，顯示腫瘤 B 細胞不共表現 CD43，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤常見的 CD43 陰性表型。
features: IHC CD43 on splenic lymphoid infiltrate, medium power
Sheets of small monotonous lymphoid cells with hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei are CD43 negative
Scattered positive cells with crisp membranous staining represent background reactive T cells
A band-like vertical concentration of CD43-positive cells, likely a residual T-cell zone or perivascular area
No aberrant CD43 co-expression on the neoplastic B-cell population
62481.describe_en: CD43 immunostain of the splenic lymphoid infiltrate shows that the sheets of small neoplastic lymphoid cells are negative. Positive staining is confined to scattered background T cells and a band-like aggregate of reactive T cells traversing the field. The absence of CD43 co-expression on the B-cell population is supportive of splenic marginal zone lymphoma, which is typically CD43 negative, in contrast to several other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: MCL B cells are usually CD43 and CD5 positive with cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression.
CLL/SLL cells co-express CD43, CD5, CD23 and LEF1, whereas SMZL is negative for these.

ddx.dx: Extranodal/nodal marginal zone lymphoma with CD43 co-expression
ddx.vs: Some non-splenic MZLs aberrantly express CD43, so the splenic distribution and clinical context rather than CD43 alone define SMZL.

62417.recognize_zh: H&E 下可見數條管壁明顯增厚的血管，管壁與周圍有均質、蠟樣、淡嗜酸性的無細胞物質，旁邊是出血與脂肪組織；這種血管壁的無定形淡粉紅沉積要懷疑類澱粉（amyloid），需以剛果紅染色確認。
features: Thick-walled medium-sized blood vessels with concentric wall expansion
Homogeneous, waxy, pale eosinophilic acellular material within and around vessel walls
Reduced cellularity of affected vessel walls
Adjacent fresh hemorrhage and adipose tissue
Fibrous stroma with scattered small vessels; lymph node parenchyma not evident in this field
62417.describe_en: Sections show fibroadipose tissue containing several thick-walled blood vessels whose walls are expanded by homogeneous, waxy, pale eosinophilic acellular material. The deposits are relatively hypocellular and extend into the perivascular stroma. Adjacent areas of fresh hemorrhage and mature adipose tissue are present; lymph node parenchyma (paracortex) is not clearly identifiable in this particular field. The findings are suggestive of vascular amyloid deposition, which should be confirmed with Congo red staining and polarization.

ddx.vs: Hyaline change affects mainly small arterioles in hypertension/diabetes and is Congo red-negative.
LCDD deposits look similar on H&E but are Congo red-negative and show granular non-fibrillar deposits by electron microscopy.
Fibrinoid necrosis is brighter eosinophilic with karyorrhectic debris and inflammatory cells in the vessel wall.

62353.recognize_zh: 脫色後的骨髓印片進行免疫染色：左圖大型異常淋巴球呈強棕色 CD20 陽性，右圖同類大細胞呈較淡的膜狀 CD10 陽性，而周圍小型背景細胞為陰性，支持 CD10+ 大 B 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Two-panel composite of immunoperoxidase stains performed on destained bone marrow imprint smears
Left panel: large cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining (CD20) among negative smaller cells
Right panel: weaker membranous staining of large cells (CD10) with many negative background cells
Granular brown background deposits and bubbles/vacuoles typical of smear-based IHC
Morphologic detail limited by destaining and smear-based immunostaining
62353.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry performed on destained bone marrow imprint smears is shown in two panels. The large atypical lymphoid cells show strong staining for CD20 (left) and membranous staining for CD10 (right), whereas smaller background hematopoietic cells are negative. Background granular deposition is present, and cytologic detail is limited by the smear-based technique. In conjunction with the imprint morphology, findings are compatible with bone marrow involvement by a CD10-positive large B-cell lymphoma (germinal center B-cell-like), with MYC/BCL2 status required to exclude high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized, CD10+ BCL6+ BCL2-negative with near-100% Ki-67 and isolated MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology and CD20/CD10 cannot separate it; FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 is required.
B-lymphoblasts are CD10+ but TdT+ and CD34+ with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are often CD20 weak or negative.

62289.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞體積大、染色質呈細緻開放的篩網狀，中央一個晚期紅血球前驅細胞核有突出的核芽（nuclear budding），左側大型粒細胞前驅細胞也偏大，呈核質發育不同步，符合巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely reticulated chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm
Late erythroid precursor with a dense nucleus and an attached nuclear bud (nuclear budding)
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in precursors with hemoglobinizing cytoplasm
Large granulocytic precursors with coarse granules and open chromatin (left of field)
Background oval macrocytes; image resolution is limited by blur at high magnification
62289.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high magnification shows enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely reticulated chromatin and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. A late erythroid precursor in the center shows a dense nucleus with an attached nuclear bud. Large granulocytic precursors with open chromatin are also present, and background red cells include oval macrocytes. Fine nuclear detail is somewhat limited by image blur, but the findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis as seen in megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Nuclear budding also occurs in MDS, but MDS lacks the global megaloblastic change with giant metamyelocytes and shows persistent dysplasia and clonal abnormalities despite normal B12/folate.
CDA shows binucleated erythroblasts and internuclear bridges confined to the erythroid lineage, without megaloblastic granulocytic precursors.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows an immature proerythroblast predominance without the orderly (though asynchronous) maturation seen here.

62033.recognize_zh: 這是一張綜合圖：A、B 為血液/骨髓抹片，可見顆粒豐富、核不規則的異常前骨髓細胞，以及紅色箭頭標示的深紫色粗顆粒嗜鹼性細胞；C 為流式細胞圖、D 為染色體核型，需以 PML::RARA 確認急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Composite figure: panels A and B smear photomicrographs, panel C flow cytometry dot plots, panel D G-banded karyotype
Panels A/B: large cells with abundant granular cytoplasm and irregular/folded nuclei, compatible with abnormal promyelocytes (black arrows indicate cells with cytoplasmic projections)
Panels A/B: cells with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus (red arrows), compatible with basophils or basophilic-type granulated cells
No Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) are discernible at this resolution
Panels C and D are too low in resolution to read antigen labels or specific chromosomal breakpoints
62033.describe_en: This composite figure combines smear morphology with flow cytometry and karyotype. The smears (panels A and B) show large abnormal granular cells with irregular folded nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm, admixed with cells bearing coarse, dark purple granules consistent with basophils (red arrows). Faggot cells and Auer rods cannot be confirmed at this resolution. Panel C shows flow cytometric dot plots with distinct colored populations and panel D a G-banded karyotype, but axis labels and chromosomal breakpoints are not legible in this image. Findings are compatible with an atypical acute promyelocytic leukemia with basophilic differentiation, as indicated in the title; the diagnosis rests on demonstration of PML::RARA by FISH, RT-PCR, or karyotype, and coagulopathy (DIC/bleeding) should be urgently evaluated.

ddx.vs: Acute basophilic leukemia shows blasts with coarse basophilic granules and metachromasia on toluidine blue but lacks PML::RARA, which defines APL.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in accelerated/blast phase
ddx.vs: CML shows basophilia with a left-shifted granulocytic series and BCR::ABL1 fusion rather than PML::RARA.
This AML is characteristically associated with marrow basophilia and multilineage dysplasia, and is separated from APL by cytogenetics/molecular testing.
NPM1-mutated AML can mimic microgranular APL with HLA-DR negativity, but lacks PML::RARA and shows NPM1 mutation by molecular testing.

61969.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 中以小型、深染、圓形的淋巴球為主，夾雜少數核稍大且不規則的中型細胞，以及細胞質豐富、核呈泡狀的組織球，並有微血管與細膠原穿插；缺乏大片大型異型細胞，符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的細胞組成。
features: Predominance of small lymphocytes with round, dense, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Admixed medium-sized cells with slightly larger, irregular nuclei
Scattered histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and vesicular, oval nuclei
Large atypical cells are rare (clearly less than 30% of the infiltrate)
Delicate capillaries and thin collagen strands traverse the infiltrate
No necrosis, angiocentricity or prominent eosinophils seen
61969.describe_en: High-power H&E section of a dermal infiltrate shows a predominance of small lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei, admixed with medium-sized lymphoid cells with mildly irregular nuclei and scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei. Thin capillaries and collagen strands traverse the infiltrate. Large atypical cells are infrequent, and there is no necrosis or angiocentric destruction. Findings are consistent with a small/medium-sized lymphoid infiltrate compatible with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, confirmed by a CD4-predominant T-cell phenotype with PD-1-positive medium-sized cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: PTCL shows more than 30% large pleomorphic cells, often with necrosis, ulceration and rapid growth.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: AITL shows systemic lymphadenopathy, arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ dendritic meshworks and EBV-positive B blasts, not a solitary cutaneous nodule.
Pseudolymphoma has a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, plasma cells and reactive follicles and lacks a clonal PD-1-positive T-cell population.

61905.recognize_zh: 低倍下皮下脂肪小葉間與脂肪細胞之間佈滿淋巴樣細胞，呈小葉性脂膜炎樣（lobular panniculitis-like）浸潤，並包圍小血管與毛囊附屬器；HV-LPD的浸潤常延伸到皮下脂肪，這張圖正顯示這種深層侵犯。
features: Lymphoid infiltrate permeating subcutaneous fat lobules between adipocytes (lobular panniculitis-like pattern)
Perivascular and perineural/periadnexal cuffing around a small vessel or nerve twig at center
Hair follicle epithelium at upper right surrounded by lymphocytes
Cells appear small to medium; rimming of individual adipocytes is not clearly resolved at this magnification
No fat necrosis or granulomas evident in this field
61905.describe_en: Low-power sections of deep dermis and subcutis show a lymphoid infiltrate permeating subcutaneous fat lobules in a lobular panniculitis-like pattern, with cuffing around a small neurovascular bundle and a hair follicle. The infiltrating cells are small to medium-sized at this magnification, and definite adipocyte rimming, fat necrosis or granulomas are not evident. Extension of the infiltrate into the subcutis in a patient with photodistributed vesiculopapular lesions and an EBER-positive cytotoxic infiltrate is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: SPTCL shows atypical CD8+ alpha-beta T cells rimming adipocytes with karyorrhexis, spares the dermis and epidermis, and is EBER-negative.
Gamma-delta TCL involves epidermis, dermis and fat with necrosis and angioinvasion, expresses TCR-gamma with TCR-beta-F1 negativity, and is EBER-negative.
Lupus panniculitis shows hyaline fat necrosis, lymphoid follicles with plasma cells and mucin, with a polyclonal EBER-negative infiltrate.

61841.recognize_zh: 周邊血中的循環異常細胞核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀凝集，部分可見核仁，細胞質淡藍且周邊有細絲狀毛狀突起（箭頭）；看似毛細胞白血病變異型（HCL-v），但偏心核與漿細胞樣染色質提示是漿細胞白血病（PCL）的罕見型態變異。
features: Circulating medium-to-large cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei
Coarse, clumped (clock-face-like) chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells (C, D)
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like projections (arrows)
Occasional paranuclear clearing suggestive of a Golgi zone
Background rouleaux formation of red cells in panels A and B
61841.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (A–D) shows circulating atypical cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and in some cells distinct nucleoli, surrounded by pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing fine, irregular hair-like projections (arrows). Red cells show rouleaux formation in the low-power fields. Although the villous cytoplasm and nucleoli mimic hairy cell leukemia variant, the eccentric nuclei, plasmacytoid chromatin, and rouleaux favor a plasma cell origin, which must be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD38/CD138 bright, cytoplasmic light-chain restriction, CD19-/CD20-). Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with hairy-cell-like morphology.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have central nuclei and express CD19/CD20/CD11c/CD103 with surface immunoglobulin, whereas PCL cells are CD38/CD138 bright with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction and lack pan-B markers.
HCL cells lack nucleoli and rouleaux association and are CD25+/CD103+/annexin A1+ with BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: SMZL villous lymphocytes are CD20+ B cells with polar short villi, with only a minor plasmacytoid component.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than a monotonous circulating plasma cell population.

61713.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中為大型芽細胞：染色質細緻、胞質豐富淡灰藍色且無顆粒，細胞輪廓不規則、可見偽足樣突起，旁邊有一個小淋巴球與一個晚期有核紅血球可作大小比較；外觀像單核球樣但無顆粒的芽細胞，是 BPDCN 抹片的線索之一。
features: Large blasts, several times the size of the adjacent small lymphocyte/orthochromatic normoblast
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Abundant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Irregular cytoplasmic outlines with tapering pseudopod-like extensions
One large cytoplasmic mass containing two nuclei (binucleate cell or overlapping cells)
No Auer rods; only faint cytoplasmic vacuolization at this magnification
61713.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and abundant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. The cell borders are irregular with tapering pseudopod-like cytoplasmic extensions, and one large cell contains two nuclei, possibly representing a binucleate form or overlapping cells. A small lymphocyte and a late normoblast provide size comparison, and no Auer rods or granules are seen. Findings are compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the appropriate immunophenotypic context, although the morphology overlaps with monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts can look nearly identical but show fine azurophilic granules, NSE positivity and CD14/CD64/lysozyme expression, so immunophenotyping is required.
Megakaryoblasts also have cytoplasmic blebs but typically have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and express CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or metastatic tumor in marrow
ddx.vs: These cells are more pleomorphic and cohesive and express CD30/ALK or epithelial markers rather than CD123/TCF4.

61649.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中異常前骨髓細胞密集，核摺疊或呈雙葉（butterfly），胞質布滿紫紅顆粒，數個細胞內可見多根交錯成束的 Auer 小體（faggot cells），是 APL 的經典診斷圖。
features: Packed abnormal promyelocytes with abundant heavily granulated cytoplasm
Nuclei folded, reniform, or bilobed (butterfly) with fine chromatin and nucleoli
Several cells with multiple crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cells)
Granules scattered in the smear background from cell breakage
Rare small lymphocytes; normal hematopoiesis largely absent
61649.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-total replacement by abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with azurophilic granules and folded, reniform, or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. Several cells contain multiple Auer rods arranged in bundles (faggot cells). Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced, with only rare lymphocytes. Findings are characteristic of acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and assessment for disseminated intravascular coagulation are indicated.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) typically has single slender Auer rods in blasts with prominent hofs and dysplastic maturing neutrophils, not faggot cells in hypergranular promyelocytes.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation, not otherwise specified
ddx.vs: Occasional Auer rods may be seen but blasts lack bilobed nuclei and dense granules, and PML::RARA is absent.
Reactive promyelocytes show round nuclei with a Golgi zone, no Auer rods, and orderly downstream maturation.

61585.recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓左側為混雜紅血球、大型未成熟細胞與深染小核紅血球前驅細胞的浸潤，右側則是一片較密集、核卵圓或有凹痕的中型細胞；整體為骨髓單核系細胞大量充塞紅髓，符合 JMML 侵犯脾臟。
features: Red pulp expanded by a dense hematopoietic infiltrate with loss of normal cord/sinus contrast
Left half: large immature cells with vesicular, oval to folded nuclei and nucleoli admixed with abundant red cells
Erythroid precursors with small dense round nuclei and scattered maturing granulocytes
Right half: densely packed medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm (monocytoid infiltrate versus residual white pulp)
No necrosis or discrete tumor nodule
61585.describe_en: H&E section of spleen shows marked expansion of the red pulp by a dense hematopoietic infiltrate. On the left, large immature cells with vesicular oval to folded nuclei and nucleoli are admixed with erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and abundant red cells; on the right, the infiltrate is more densely packed and composed of medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Whether the denser area represents a monocytic infiltrate or residual white pulp cannot be determined on H&E alone and requires immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Trilineage red pulp hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and without a dense monocytic component.
Shows sheets of blasts with CD34/CD117 positivity and little maturation.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by B-lymphoblastic or other lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells would be CD19/PAX5 or CD3 positive and MPO/CD14-negative, forming white pulp–based or diffuse monotonous sheets.

61521.recognize_zh: 多個散在的大型多核細胞 CD30 強陽性，呈細胞膜加上核旁高基氏體點狀（membrane + Golgi）染色，而周圍大量小淋巴球為陰性；這種「稀疏大細胞、背景反應性」的分布是古典何杰金淋巴瘤的典型 CD30 型態。
features: Scattered large cells, many binucleated or multinucleated, with abundant cytoplasm
Strong CD30 membranous staining with dense paranuclear Golgi-zone accentuation
Positive cells are dispersed singly and in small clusters rather than in sheets
Background of numerous small CD30-negative lymphocytes
Nuclei of positive cells appear as clear, vesicular spaces outlined by stained cytoplasm
61521.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 highlights numerous scattered large mono- and multinucleated cells in a background of small negative lymphocytes. The large cells show strong membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi accentuation. Positive cells are distributed singly and in small aggregates without forming cohesive sheets. Findings are consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 in cohesive sheets or sinusoidal aggregates of hallmark cells, often ALK+ and CD15-, rather than scattered HRS cells in a reactive background.
Activated immunoblasts are smaller, show weaker variable CD30 in a spectrum of cell sizes, and are CD20+/PAX5+ without the CD15+ multinucleated HRS phenotype.
PMBL has sheets of CD30-weak/variable large cells with strong CD20, CD79a, and OCT2, instead of scattered CD20-negative HRS cells.

61457.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞樣細胞核內有一個圓形、淡粉紅色的包涵體，看似位於核內並將染色質推向周邊，即 Dutcher body；背景混有小淋巴球、漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Arrowed plasmacytoid cell with a round, pale eosinophilic, sharply delineated intranuclear (pseudo)inclusion - Dutcher body
Mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs
Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei and occasional mast cell/histiocyte-like cells
Scattered red cells and fat spaces in marrow/tissue section
No sheets of large atypical cells in this field
61457.describe_en: Section shows a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells.
